description.value: The Port McNeill Visitor Information Centre is the official municipal tourism gateway for Port McNeill on northern Vancouver Island, operated by the Town of Port McNeill. It provides information on local attractions including whale watching, the world's largest burl, Broughton Strait Campground, and the Outer Islands. For touring cyclists exploring northern Vancouver Island, this centre is a useful stop for regional information and trip planning.
